knowledge.textOver: Over the limit. Shorten it to save. We never cut it for you.
knowledge.sizeNote: This much goes to the model with every reply. The longer it is, the higher the cost and response time.
knowledge.publicWarning: Whatever you put here can be quoted word for word in replies to visitors. Only add information that is fine to make public.
knowledge.faqAnswerPlaceholder: Write the answer you would like the bot to give.
knowledge.faqQuestionPlaceholder: e.g. Until when can I get a refund?
knowledge.faqEmpty: None yet. Add the first one below.
knowledge.faqHint: Writing questions and answers separately helps the bot find them much better.

errors.network: Couldn't save because of a network error

knowledge.saved: Saved. Replies use this content from now on.
knowledge.emptyNote: While knowledge is empty, the bot doesn't answer factual questions (policies, prices, quantities) and hands off with “{holding}”. It still replies to feedback as usual. Add knowledge here and it answers within that range right away.
knowledge.textPlaceholder: Paste what the bot needs to know about {name}: how to use it, pricing, shipping and refund rules, common situations.
knowledge.textNote: You can paste what you already wrote in Notion or a README as is. Anything not here, the bot doesn't make up. It hands off with “{holding}”.
knowledge.faqOver: There are more than {max} frequently asked questions.

appearance.previewReply: I will check and let you know.
appearance.previewVisitor: My coupon box keeps looking empty
appearance.previewTitle: What visitors see (first screen + sample bubbles)
appearance.bubbleHelp: Background of the bubbles visitors send. The text color is picked automatically between white and black by brightness.
appearance.accentHelp: Used on the floating button, unread badge, profile initial, send button, links and the fixed-notification card. The text color on top is picked automatically between white and black by brightness, and a light color makes links and borders slightly darker.
appearance.colorsHelp: If empty, Feedloop default colors are used. Add your brand color and the widget looks like part of your site.
appearance.imageUrlHelp: A 512×512 square PNG/JPG is recommended. File upload isn't ready yet, so enter a public URL for now.
appearance.operatorNameHelp: The name attached to replies you send from the Inbox.
appearance.fallbackNote: A question you write in the field above always wins. This choice only applies when that field is empty.
appearance.fallbackOffNote: The first screen shows only the greeting and the feedback button. The knowledge is still used and the bot answers when visitors ask on their own.
appearance.greetingHelp: The first bubble visitors see when they open the widget.
appearance.statusTextHelp: One line under the display name. A place to say in advance when replies usually arrive.
appearance.displayNameHelp: Used in the widget header and the floating button. If empty, the bot name is used.

errors.network: Couldn't save because of a network error

appearance.saved: Saved. It reaches the visitor widget within a few minutes.
appearance.starterExample1: How many coupons can I get per day?
appearance.startersHelp: One per line, up to {max} (each up to {chars} characters). They appear under the greeting, and when a visitor taps one it is sent right away and answered on the spot.
appearance.fallbackOnNote: The first FAQ questions are shown to visitors as they are. Right now that starts with “{first}” and shows {count, plural, one {# question} other {# questions}}.
appearance.fallbackOnEmpty: If you add FAQs to the knowledge, the first questions are shown to visitors. There are no FAQs right now, so nothing shows.

defaults.statusText: Usually replies in a few minutes
defaults.greeting: Hi! Tell us anything that bothered you or anything you'd like while using {name}. Our team reads and answers every message.

new.prAutoBody: Every day at 09:00 a fix PR is opened for the largest new group. A person still decides what ships. You can change this later on the Bots screen.
new.prApproveBody: For each group, click [Create fix PR] in the dashboard. A person checks first that the AI fix is right.
new.githubTokenHelp: A fine-grained token (Contents and Pull requests: Read and write, that repository only) that lets PRs be opened from your account on the repository above. If empty, Feedloop tries with its shared account, which only works on repositories that account was invited to as a collaborator. You can add one later in settings.
new.repoUrlHelp: The repository where fix PRs are opened from feedback.
new.fixSub: If empty, it only triages and creates no fix PRs
new.keyFailedNote: The bot is registered but the key wasn't saved. Fix the key and save again, or add it later under Bots → API key.
new.ownBody: Pick the model yourself and answer with no limit. You pay through your own key.
new.ownTitle: Start with my own API key
new.aiSub: Starts answering as soon as the widget is connected
new.serviceDescriptionPlaceholder: A short description of your product and what feedback you expect
new.serviceNameHelp: The name that tells your bots apart in the dashboard.
new.basicSub: The name and address used in the dashboard and widget
new.lockedNote: The bot is already registered. Only the key is saved now; you can change the other details on the Bots screen.
new.description: Register the bot that will receive feedback. You choose the feedback channel (Channel Talk or web widget) on the next screen.
new.title: Register a new bot

errors.register: Something went wrong while registering the bot.

new.githubFail: Couldn't save the GitHub token — {reason}. You can add it again after connecting, under “Knowledge › GitHub”.
new.afterRegister: After you register you go to the connect screen. There you either attach to the Channel Talk chat you already use or, if you have no support channel, add one widget line to your site. You can change this later or attach both.
new.freeBody: Up to {limit, number} replies a day, free. Answers with {model}.
new.aiNote: Either way, a fact that isn't in the knowledge isn't made up: the bot hands off with “{holding}”. You can change this later on the Bots screen.

delete.confirmLabel: Type the bot name exactly to confirm
delete.body: Conversations, feedback, groups, fix PR records, knowledge and the API key are all deleted and this can't be undone. PRs and branches already created on GitHub stay. The widget on your site stops showing.
delete.title: Delete “{name}”?
